description: This file defines the S3ExpressSignature class, which extends the S3SignatureV4 class to implement AWS S3 request signing specific to 's3express', including request modification for security token headers.

classes.name: S3ExpressSignature
classes.description: A class extending S3SignatureV4 that signs and presigns S3 requests with modifications tailored for 's3express' service, including token header adjustments.

methods.name: signRequest
methods.description: Signs an S3 request with provided credentials, modifying token headers if needed.

methods.name: presign
methods.description: Generates a presigned URL for S3 access, incorporating token header modifications.

methods.name: modifyTokenHeaders
methods.description: Removes existing security token headers and adds the 'x-amz-s3session-token' header with credentials' security token.

methods.name: getSigningCredentials
methods.description: Creates a new Credentials object using the access key and secret key from provided credentials, excluding the security token.
